findings.failureScenario: An empty Authorization token reaches the protected handler as an authenticated request.

verification.refutationAttempt: Followed the empty-string branch and tried to prove the handler rejects a falsey token.
verification.evidence: The new guard rejects only a missing header; an empty parsed token still reaches the protected handler.

findings.failureScenario: The empty-token regression ships because the suite exercises only missing and valid headers.

verification.refutationAttempt: Searched parameterized and integration coverage for an empty Authorization token case.
verification.evidence: The suite covers absent, malformed, and valid headers but contains no empty-token assertion.

dropped.failureScenario: Tenant B requests the same object id as tenant A and receives tenant A's cached value.

verification.refutationAttempt: Traced every caller and reconstructed the effective key for two tenants sharing an object id.
verification.evidence: The caller prefixes the tenant id before invoking this cache helper, so the alleged collision is unreachable.
